deal_close_policy.content: Revenue Ops Daily Close Policy v4. (1) An opportunity may move to Closed Won only when a fully executed envelope (all required signers, including internal countersign) matches the opportunity amount within $0. (2) Amount discrepancies between envelope and opportunity must be escalated to the deal owner and resolved before stage change. (3) Completion emails to the customer contact are sent only after the opportunity is marked Closed Won. (4) The #deals-won channel post and the renewal follow-up task are generated as part of the same close transaction.

tools.name: list_completed_envelopes
tools.object: DocuSign envelopes completed on a given date
tools.description: Lists DocuSign envelopes whose status became 'completed' on the specified date, returning envelope IDs, subjects, and completion timestamps.

tools.name: get_envelope_details
tools.object: a single DocuSign envelope's signers, amount, and custom fields
tools.description: Retrieves full details for one completed envelope: signer list and signing times, document-stated contract value, and any embedded CRM opportunity hint.

tools.name: find_matching_opportunities
tools.object: Salesforce opportunities linked to completed envelopes
tools.description: Queries Salesforce for opportunities matching a set of completed envelopes by linked-envelope field or account/contact, returning stage, amount, owner, and contact.

tools.name: reconcile_envelope_to_opportunity
tools.description: Compares each completed envelope against its candidate opportunity, checking amount parity, signer completeness (including internal countersign), and match cleanliness, then flags discrepancies and orphan envelopes.

tools.name: assemble_daily_close_summary
tools.object: a daily close summary of affected accounts, amounts, and flags
tools.description: Drafts the daily close summary listing each completed contract, the matched account and amount, reconciliation flags, and recommended actions, for the user to review before anything is committed.

tools.name: update_salesforce_opportunity
tools.object: a Salesforce opportunity's stage and amount
tools.description: Updates an opportunity record in Salesforce (e.g. sets stage to Closed Won and writes the executed amount). This mutates production CRM data.

tools.name: send_contract_completion_email
tools.object: a contract-completion confirmation email to the customer or rep
tools.description: Sends an email confirming contract completion to the customer contact and/or the deal owner. Once sent it cannot be recalled.

tools.name: post_close_summary_to_channel
tools.object: a daily close / deal-won announcement to a Slack channel
tools.description: Posts the close summary or deal-won announcement to a Slack channel such as #deals-won, broadcasting the affected accounts and amounts to the team.

tools.name: create_salesforce_followup_task
tools.object: a Salesforce follow-up task on an opportunity or account
tools.description: Creates a renewal or onboarding follow-up task in Salesforce tied to the closed opportunity. This writes a new production CRM record.

tools.name: read_deal_close_policy
tools.object: the Revenue Ops daily close policy document
tools.description: Retrieves the Revenue Operations daily close policy describing close requirements, amount-discrepancy escalation, and communication sequencing.

tools.name: lookup_revops_directory
tools.object: the Revenue Operations team directory and channel list
tools.description: Looks up RevOps team members, deal owners, signature authority, and available Slack channels for reference.
